bullets.text: Residents blocked the Chennai-Tirupati highway near Periyapalayam for 30 minutes to protest a five-hour power outage, and the office should monitor local electricity supply.
PMK leader Anbumani urged Chief Minister Vijay to directly intervene in the Pallikaranai marshland issue, and the office should track environmental developments.
Gummidipoondi fire and rescue personnel participated in a fire-free Diwali awareness event at KLK Government Boys School, and the district team should note safety campaigns.
LiveX and NVIDIA launched AI City at the Smart City Expo in Barcelona to bring physical artificial intelligence to airports and hospitals, and the portfolio team should observe new AI applications.

stories.title: பெரியபாளையம் அருகே 5 மணிநேரம் மின்வெட்டு கண்டித்து சாலை மறியல்
takeaways: Public blocked the Chennai Tirupati highway near Periyapalayam for thirty minutes demanding restoration after prolonged power outages.
District officials must address persistent electricity disruptions in Thiruvallur to prevent further traffic blockades and public unrest.

The local administration is promoting safety measures ahead of the festive season to prevent accidents.

stories.title: LiveX Brings Physical AI to Airports, Hospitals and Stores With the Launch of AI City
takeaways: LiveX and NVIDIA launched AI City at the Smart City Expo World Congress in Barcelona.
The new platform introduces physical artificial intelligence applications for airports, hospitals, and retail stores.
